spanish: Y darás la parójet debajo de los ganchos, y harás entrar allá desde dentro a la parójet el arca del testimonio, y separará la parójet a ustedes entre el santo y entre santo de los santos.

findings.issue: parójet leaves common noun H6532 untranslated; a common noun must be Spanish.
לָכֶם is a prepositional beneficiary (for you). separará a ustedes makes the addressees the object separated; the hiphil divides between the two holy domains.
Construct noun בית is smoothed to the adverb dentro, and desde…a reads as a path toward the curtain rather than the locative from-house-of plus ל.

notes: Tú on darás/harás and ustedes for the 2mp suffix match the person shift; both בין phrases are kept.
